name: panax ginseng root + zingiber officinale (ginger) root oil
purpose: Improves Scalp Environment Promotes Hair Growth
uses: 1、Cleanse your scalp before use 2、Apply the serum evenly to the scalp 3、Massage gently into the scalp to promote absorption 4、Finish by brushing your hair as usual and don't rinse it out
otcwarn: For External Use Only. Avoid Direct Contact with Eyes. If the product gets into your eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water. Discontinue Use if Irritation Occurs. Keep Out of Reach of Children.
